Weaver.reason: WEAVER LINE: Bank Holiday Monday 25, Tuesday 26, Wednesday 27 and Thursday 28 May, after 2245 each evening, no service between Hackney Downs and Chingford. Replacement bus service L3 operates between Hackney Downs and Chingford via Clapton, St James Street, Walthamstow Central, Wood Street and Highams Park. The last three northbound buses start at 0014 0044 and 0114 from Liverpool Street and also serve Bethnal Green, Cambridge Heath and London Fields.
